ei.title: Chapter 4-10 2번: The Human Need for Companionship
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its intensity varies from person to person. An equally impelling impulse, though, is to seek the company of others and to spend extended periods of time sharing activities. In these periods we exchange information and feelings in both conversational and non-verbal forms (facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, touching, and so on). We need other people to provide us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, reassurance, physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to confirm that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is unique and separate from anyone else. Thus, we generally cannot exist for too long without seeking companionship.

questions.passage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its intensity varies from person to person. An equally (A)[trivial / impelling] impulse, though, is to seek the company of others and to spend extended periods of time sharing activities. In these periods we (B)[exchange / withhold] information and feelings in both conversational and non-verbal forms (facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, touching, and so on). We need other people to provide us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, reassurance, physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to confirm that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is (C)[unique / common] and separate from anyone else. Thus, we generally cannot exist for too long without seeking companionship.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 마찬가지로 강렬한 충동, 정보와 감정을 교환하다, 고유하고 구별되는 정체성.
det.analysis:
✅ ① impelling — exchange — unique — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② trivial — exchange — unique (A 반대: 강렬한→하찮은)
❌ ③ impelling — withhold — unique (B 반대: 교환하다→숨기다)
❌ ④ impelling — exchange — common (C 반대: 고유한→흔한)

questions.passage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its intensity (A)[varies / remains] from person to person. An equally impelling impulse, though, is to seek the company of others and to spend extended periods of time sharing activities. In these periods we exchange information and feelings in both conversational and non-verbal forms (facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, touching, and so on). We need other people to (B)[deny / provide] us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, reassurance, physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to (C)[confirm / question] that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is unique and separate from anyone else. Thus, we generally cannot exist for too long without seeking companionship.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 강도는 사람마다 다르고(varies), 사랑과 지지를 제공하고(provide), 우리 존재를 확인한다(confirm).
det.analysis:
❌ ① remains — provide — confirm (A 반대: 다르다→동일하다)
❌ ② varies — deny — confirm (B 반대: 제공하다→거부하다)
✅ ③ varies — provide — confirm — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ varies — provide — question (C 반대: 확인하다→의문을 갖다)

questions.passage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its intensity varies from person to person. An equally impelling impulse, though, is to seek the company of others and to spend (A)[brief / extended] periods of time sharing activities. In these periods we exchange information and feelings in both conversational and non-verbal forms (facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, touching, and so on). We need other people to provide us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, (B)[reassurance / uncertainty], physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to confirm that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is unique and (C)[separate / identical] from anyone else. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 장기간(extended)의 활동 공유, 안심감(reassurance)을 제공, 누구와도 구별되는(separate) 정체성.
det.analysis:
❌ ① brief — reassurance — separate (A 반대: 장기간→짧은)
❌ ② extended — uncertainty — separate (B 반대: 안심감→불확실성)
❌ ③ extended — reassurance — identical (C 반대: 구별되는→동일한)
✅ ④ extended — reassurance — separate — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its ①<u>intensity</u> varies from person to person. An equally ②<u>negligible</u> impulse, though, is to seek the company of others and to spend extended periods of time sharing activities. In these periods we ③<u>exchange</u> information and feelings in both conversational and non-verbal forms (facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, touching, and so on). We need other people to provide us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, reassurance, physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to confirm that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is unique and separate from anyone else. Thus, we generally cannot exist for too long without seeking ④<u>companionship</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '무시해도 되는(negligible)'이 아니라 '강렬한(impelling)'이 적절. 혼자 있고 싶은 욕구만큼 강렬한 충동이 타인을 찾는 것이다.
det.analysis:
① intensity — 강도, 원문 일치
② negligible — 원문은 impelling(강렬한) ←정답
③ exchange — 교환하다, 원문 일치
④ companionship — 교우관계, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Although the wish to be alone is often strong, its intensity varies from person to person. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '동일한(identical)'이 아니라 '고유한(unique)'이 적절. 우리의 정체성이 다른 사람과 구별되고 고유하다는 것.
det.analysis:
① approval — 승인, 원문 일치
② reassurance — 안심감, 원문 일치
③ myriad — 무수한, 원문 일치
④ identical — 원문은 unique(고유한) ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '합쳐진(merged)'이 아니라 '분리된(separate)'이 적절. 정체성이 다른 누구와도 구별되고 분리된 것이라는 맥락.
det.analysis:
① bodily — 신체적인, 원문 일치
② practical — 실용적인, 원문 일치
③ emotional — 감정적인, 원문 일치
④ merged — 원문은 separate(분리된) ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 너무 오랫동안 교우관계(companionship)를 찾지 않고는 존재할 수 없다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① solitude — 고독, 문맥 반대
✅ ② companionship — 교우관계, 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ independence — 독립, 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ competition — 경쟁, 문맥 부적합
det.tip: 글 전체가 인간의 사회적 교류 욕구를 설명하며, 결론에서 companionship(교우관계)을 추구함을 강조한다.

det.analysis:

❌ ② punishment — 처벌, 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ resistance — 저항, 문맥 부적합

det.tip: love, support, approval은 인간이 타인에게 기대하는 긍정적 요소의 나열이다.

❌ ③ duration(지속 시간) — 시간의 길이를 의미

❌ ④ direction(방향) — 향하는 쪽을 의미

det.analysis:

✅ ② countless — 셀 수 없이 많은 ←정답

det.analysis:

❌ ③ repeated — 반복되는

det.korean: practical = 실용적인, 실제적인.
det.analysis:
❌ ① useful — 유용한 (유사)
✅ ② theoretical — 이론적인 ←정답
❌ ③ essential — 필수적인
❌ ④ functional — 기능적인 (유사)

questions.passage:
(A) An equally impelling impulse is to seek the <u>company</u> of others and to spend extended periods of time sharing activities.

(B) She joined a large <u>company</u> as a marketing manager after graduating from college.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 company의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 타인의 함께함(동행)을 추구하다 / (B) 대기업에 입사하다(회사).
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 회사 — (B) 회사: (A)에서 seek the company of others는 '타인과의 동행'이지 '회사'가 아님
❌ ② (A) 동행 — (B) 동행: (B)에서 joined a large company는 '회사에 입사'임
✅ ③ (A) 동행 — (B) 회사 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 회사 — (B) 동행: 두 의미가 모두 반대
det.tip: company: ① 동행, 함께함 (the company of others) ② 회사 (a large company)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the act of giving something to someone or making it available to them"

det.korean: provide = 제공하다 (누군가에게 무언가를 주거나 이용 가능하게 하는 행위).
det.analysis:
✅ ① provide — 제공하다 ←정답
❌ ② exchange — 교환하다
❌ ③ confirm — 확인하다
❌ ④ vary — 다르다
det.tip: provide(제공하다): 타인에게 사랑, 지지, 승인 등을 '제공하다'라는 맥락에서 사용됨.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 대화의(conversational) + 비언어적 형태로 정보와 감정을 교환한다.
det.analysis: converse(동사: 대화하다) → conversational(형용사: 대화의). 빈칸 뒤 'and non-verbal forms'에서 형용사 형태가 필요함을 알 수 있다.

det.tip: reassure(동사) → reassurance(명사). 같은 나열 구조에서 품사를 맞춘다.

We need other people to provide us with love, support, approval, bodily contact, reassurance, physical help and a myriad of other practical, physical and emotional needs. In a very basic sense we need others to confirm that we are there, that we exist and that we have an identity that is __________ from anyone else. Thus, we generally cannot exist for too long without seeking companionship.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다른 누구와도 고유하고 구별되는(unique and separate) 정체성을 가지고 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① complex and emotional — 복잡하고 감정적인, 문맥 부적합
✅ ② unique and separate — 고유하고 구별되는, 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ simple and ordinary — 단순하고 평범한, 원문 반대
❌ ④ private and hidden — 사적이고 숨겨진, 문맥 부적합
det.tip: an identity that is unique and separate from anyone else — 정체성의 '고유성'과 '구별성'이 글의 핵심이다.
